about_the_game:
Hope in hard Times...

After losing her memory, Alice sets out on on a journey to find her father. Her search leads her into a new world ravaged by a brutal civil war in Eastern Europe. Caught between opposing factions, she witnesses the struggles of common man, stuck between clashing ideologies. As Alice navigates this harsh reality, she uncovers both the relentless cruelty of war and the unexpected warmth of human connection. Experience this story as a visual novel.

  • Branching Choices: Shape the story by selecting from multiple events that influence Alice’s journey.

  • Unique Art Style: Explore a world with a unique artistic design.

  • Compelling Storyline: Dive into an emotional tale that explores themes of conflict, and hope.

content_descriptors.notes: May contain scenes of alcohol consumption, violence, and images of mutilated bodies.
